Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred from the IMDb “Robert Ludlum’s The Bourne Betrayal (Video 2007)” page that the listed Narrator (voice), Jeremy Davidson, “applies to the title character,” Jason Bourne. This conflated a narration credit for a video/audiobook-type entry with portraying the title character, and ignored that The Bourne Betrayal is a novel (no widely released film by that title). The correct association for the title character in the Bourne films is Matt Damon, so this inference would lead to the wrong answer.
